pretreatments.description: Dilute citric acid pretreatment of sugarcane bagasse. Conditions included: Temperature (T) varying from 120 to 180 °C, reaction time (t) from 20 to 90 min, and percentage by weight of citric acid (PCA) to SCB varying from 3 to 12 wt%. Equipment: 30 g raw SCB in 475 mL 316L-grade stainless steel tubular reactor (autoclave type) with 150 mL aqueous citric acid solution, heated in a 25 L thermostatic bath (Marconi, model MA-159) using glycerin as heating fluid. Methodology: 2^3 Doehlert experimental design (DED) with five replicates at the center point (CP) and 10 replicates at extreme points. Liquid and solid (SF) fractions were separated by hydraulic press at 9 tons. Liquid fraction released after pressing stored in freezer; solid fractions characterized for yield, cellulose, hemicelluloses, and lignin.
